mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, nickname, role, admin_approved, banned, auth_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted from pw_user where lower(username) = lower(#{username}) and deleted = 0 limit 1
select id, username, password_hash, nickname, role, admin_approved, banned, auth_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted from pw_user where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash, nickname, role, admin_approved, banned, auth_version, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pw_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM pw_user WHERE role = 'ADMIN' AND admin_approved = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND banned = 0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: insert into pw_user (username, password_hash, nickname) values (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname})
mapper.update: UPDATE pw_user SET banned = CASE WHEN #{banned} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pw_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
